study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
outcome: Respiratory morbidity defined as respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) or transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN) resulting in neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission
cohort: 581 neonates born at ≥34 weeks' gestation to mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
finding: Exposure to labor was associated with decreased odds of respiratory morbidity requiring NICU admission in neonates born to mothers with GDM.
mod_finding: Exposure to labor was associated with decreased odds of respiratory morbidity requiring NICU admission in neonates born to mothers with GDM.
